prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-03-19, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-03-19):
| Current ratio           | 1.34 |
| Retained earnings       | 22,804M |
| Current liabilities     | 20,957M |
| Current assets          | 28,007M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 31,211M |
| Total liabilities       | 34,289M |
| Total assets            | 67,064M |
| EBIT / operating income | 2,494M |
| Revenue                 | 18,044M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows solid but not exceptional liquidity (current ratio 1.34) and a leverage profile where total liabilities are roughly in line with shareholders’ equity, with positive EBIT. While profitability is decent, the absence of strong liquidity cushions and limited interest coverage data suggest modest risk relative to top-tier issuers, placing the rating at the lower end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB+
